# Google AI Mode Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/google-ai-mode-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/google-ai-mode-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.79**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Scrape Google AI Mode answers for any search query. Extract the full AI-generated response, cited sources with links and titles, and follow-up questions. Set location and language per query. Ideal for GEO, and answer-engine monitoring. Connect to your agent via MCP or export to JSON, CSV, or Excel.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Actor Start $0.00005, Google AI Mode $0.2 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/google-ai-mode-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-google-ai-mode-scraper@0.0.79#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      queries: "…"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `queries` | string | yes |  | Search query/queries — The queries to send to Google AI Mode. Enter one query per line. |
| `countryCode` | string |  |  | Country — Country from which the query is sent to AI Mode. By default, the Actor uses United States. If AI Mode does not support the selected country, the query returns no result. |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
